description: This file implements HTTP authentication and authorization for the server, supporting basic, digest, and external schemes. It includes cache management, nonce handling, and parsing of authentication headers.

classes.name: http_auth_cache
classes.description: Structure for caching authentication entries with a splay tree for fast lookup.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for the authentication plugin containing backend, rules, cache, and external auth flags.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main data structure for plugin instance, including defaults.

classes.name: http_auth_cache_entry
classes.description: Represents a cached authentication entry with associated metadata.

classes.name: http_auth_digest_params_t
classes.description: Holds parsed digest authorization parameters from client request.

classes.name: http_auth_info_t
classes.description: Contains user credentials and related info during authentication process.

methods.name: http_auth_cache_entry * http_auth_cache_entry_init(const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const int dalgo,const char * k,const uint32_t klen,const char * username,const uint32_t ulen,const char * pw,const uint32_t pwlen)
methods.description: Initializes and allocates a new cache entry for authentication data.

methods.name: void http_auth_cache_entry_free(void * data)
methods.description: Frees a cache entry, zeroing out sensitive data.

methods.name: void http_auth_cache_free(http_auth_cache * ac)
methods.description: Frees an entire authentication cache, including all entries.

methods.name: http_auth_cache * http_auth_cache_init(const array * opts)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new authentication cache based on plugin options.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_auth_cache_hash(const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const char * username,const uint32_t ulen)
methods.description: Computes a hash value for cache keys based on require and username.

methods.name: http_auth_cache_entry * http_auth_cache_query(splay_tree ** const sptree,const int ndx)
methods.description: Looks up a cache entry by hash index.

methods.name: void http_auth_cache_insert(splay_tree ** const sptree,const int ndx,void * const data,void (data_free_fn)(void *))
methods.description: Inserts a new cache entry or replaces an existing one.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_require_parse_array(const array * value,array * const auth_require,log_error_st * errh)
methods.description: Parses the auth.require array of rules, extracting method, realm, algorithms, and requirements.

methods.name: void mod_auth_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges a single plugin config value into the current configuration.

methods.name: void mod_auth_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges all plugin config values from global or context-specific settings.

methods.name: void mod_auth_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Copies defaults and overlays configuration for each request.

methods.name: mod_auth_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default plugin configuration from server config, parsing directives.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_uri_handler(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Main URI handler that picks and applies auth rules on incoming requests.

methods.name: int mod_auth_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting function pointers and registering scheme handlers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t mod_auth_send_400_bad_request(request_st * const r)
__attribute_noinline__ handler_t mod_auth_send_401_unauthorized_basic(request_st * const r,const buffer * const realm)
methods.description: Sends HTTP 401 Unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate header for Basic auth.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t mod_auth_basic_misconfigured(request_st * const r,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Logs error when Basic backend is misconfigured.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_check_basic(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Performs Basic authentication check, decoding credentials and validating.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_check_digest(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Performs Digest authentication, parsing headers, validating nonces, and computing response.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_check_extern(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Checks if REMOTE_USER environment matches auth rules for external authentication.
